§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Steam and fluid cache nodes each have standard, reinforced, and overpressure variants. Capacity, rate, and binding requirements depend on type; steam and water nodes have different singularity-cost rules, and overpressure nodes have hub-chip requirements. Check the machine information before configuring them.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Choose ordinary, enhanced, and overpressure versions as needed; this introduction does not require deploying all of them. Identify the transferred medium, then check capacity, binding cost, and hub-chip requirements. Steam-node rules do not automatically apply to water nodes. Before upgrades or relocation, confirm hub compatibility and inspect the actual configuration in the interface.
